findings.reason: The test expects a 'link' mark, but the page editor has no Link extension. Tiptap v2 StarterKit does not include Link, @tiptap/extension-link is not a dependency (it is missing from package.json and from node_modules/@tiptap), and registrations.ts registers no link mark. PageRefNode's link_open rewrite also skips absolute hrefs (`/^[a-z]+:/i`), so `[link](https://example.com)` loses its <a> when ProseMirror parses it and stays plain text 'link'. `expect(marks).toContain('link')` will therefore fail in the env-runner suite. Fix it one of two ways: drop 'link' from the asserted marks (and the `[link](…)` from BODY, or assert that it stays readable text), or use a relative .md link that PageRefNode turns into a pageRef node, which needs an index in qc. Do not claim a mark the editor does not have.
